name: Attnd
description: Attnd: event backend, API and organizer console

API_KEY.description: Static bearer key for dev/CI builds only. Production apps use attestation JWTs.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI key for AI event import/refresh

INGEST_RUN_INLINE.description: Run AI jobs in the web dyno (1) or only in the worker dyno (0)

CLOUDINARY_URL.description: Cloudinary media storage (set by the Cloudinary add-on). Without it uploads use the dyno filesystem and are lost on restart.
